list_fallback_providers: list the current fallback provider chain configured in hermes agent
add_fallback_provider: add a new fallback provider to the chain using an interactive picker
remove_fallback_provider: remove a specific fallback provider from the chain by selecting it interactively
clear_fallback_providers: clear all fallback providers from the chain after user confirmation
dispatch_fallback_command: dispatch a fallback subcommand like list, add, remove, or clear
